_readme: Editorial triage inputs. Only rows whose facts were read on an official page (sourceStatus = checked) are listed. scale = 0-3 for the documented headline cash prize (0 = no cash amount stated, 1 = under $10k, 2 = $10k-$99,999, 3 = $100k or more). effort = low | medium | high, describing the work needed to enter a credible submission. These are editorial judgements, not measurements, and they are shown next to every score on the site.

espn-pickem.rationale: Free, weekly picks, $102,000 documented, and no build work — the lowest-effort verified cash path in the dataset.

kaggle.rationale: Per-competition prizes including a $450,000 paper track, but winning requires a strong ML model or research paper.

arcprize.rationale: $2,000,000 across three tracks, but the 2026 submission deadline is 2026-11-02 — only usable now as a next-cycle reference.

drivendata.rationale: Hosts six-figure prize challenges (GEMS: $300,000); entry needs a full modelling submission.

gems-prize-2026.rationale: $300,000, closes 2026-12-03, needs a geological fault-detection model.

metaculus.rationale: Free entry, pools up to $50,000, and the work is forecasting rather than building.

midterms-2026.rationale: $10,000 pool, free entry, closes 2026-11-04 — act now or skip.

sony-world-photo.rationale: Free entry, $25,000 overall Series prize, deadline 2027-01-12; needs a 5-10 image body of work.

wergle-flomp.rationale: No fee, $5,100 total, one 250-line humor poem, open until 2027-04-01.

reedsy-weekly.rationale: $250 weekly with a new prompt each week, but the official page does not state an entry fee, so free entry is unconfirmed.

weather-potw.rationale: Free entry confirmed, prize amount not stated on the page read.

epoty.rationale: Free entry confirmed for all ages, prize amount and current deadline not stated in text on the page read.

vocal.rationale: Free to enter non-Vocal+ challenges; prize amounts vary per challenge.

devpost.rationale: Prize totals are large but must be built for; entry fee and eligibility are not stated on the listing page.

tom-howard-poetry.rationale: $12,000 in prizes but $27 per submission, so it is excluded from free-entry ranking.

givling.rationale: Crowdfunding queue rather than a judged contest; no documented cash prize for skill.

herox.rationale: Directory of federal challenges; individual prize sizes are not on the directory page.

usagov-challenges.rationale: Official U.S. government directory of active federal prize competitions; it lists contests but does not itself award a prize.

codex-twitchcon.rationale: $25,000 in prizes with free entry, but submissions close 2026-11-02 and a complete Codex build plus demo video is required.

paypal-ai-hackathon.rationale: Free entry confirmed and the event advertises $67,500, but no cash amount was read in the rules, so it earns no prize points.

espn-survivor.rationale: $25,000 grand prize confirmed on the official page, but entry creation had closed by 2026-11-01.

espn-wintotals.rationale: $5,000 total prizes confirmed; low effort, small pool.

espn-playoff.rationale: $10,000 grand prize confirmed, but the game was locked at the time of the parallel read.

espn-cfb.rationale: $86,000 across 46 prizes confirmed; free to enter, weekly commitment.

cbs-pro-pickem.rationale: Weekly $1,000 and season-long $5,000 confirmed; the advertised $100,000 perfect bracket is a contingency prize.

mlb-beat-the-streak.rationale: A $5,600,000 annuity is documented, but the official window ends with the 2026 regular season, so it is not enterable at this reading date.

gamersaloon.rationale: $10 per weekly 1-Rounder, paid as Bonus Cash that cannot be withdrawn.

rotoballer.rationale: $500 cash grand prize confirmed, but the draft window ended 2026-09-08.

deriv-tournaments.rationale: Free demo-trading tournament paying $1,000/$600/$400 monthly with no deposit; 14-day leaderboard consistency is the barrier.
